summary: Frontend-only regression completed on public preview URL across required public routes and target viewports (320x700, 390x844, 768x900, 1440x900). Route rendering/overflow checks passed broadly, mobile nav behavior and reduced-motion startup behavior passed, and investor/customer film routes remained functional. Found two UX/accessibility regressions and one console-noise issue against the stated acceptance criteria.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (390x844), visible demo control [data-testid='demo-guided-tour-button'] renders at 34px height, below the 44x44 minimum touch-target requirement.

ui_bugs.component: Customer onboarding form fields on mobile
ui_bugs.issue: Relevant mobile input text sizes are below 16px (problem textarea ~15px; picker search input ~11px), which can trigger iOS zoom and fails the explicit 16px mobile form-text requirement.

integration_issues.issue: /map/not-found triggers repeated 404 network console errors for /api/decision-maps/not-found; route UI works but violates strict no-console-errors criterion.

action_items: Raise mobile home demo guided-tour control to >=44px hit area without changing visual language or layout structure.
Set relevant mobile form control font-size to >=16px for customer onboarding fields/search pickers to prevent iOS zoom.
Suppress or handle expected map-missing 404 fetch behavior to avoid browser console error spam for /map/not-found.
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause for hit-area failure: cinematic showcase CSS sets .exported-demo-showcase .demo-chapter-actions button/a min-height:34px in mobile-visible context.
Root cause for iOS-zoom risk: investor onboarding CSS uses small text sizing for key controls (e.g., problem textarea and picker search input) below 16px on phone viewports.
Map missing route currently performs real decision-map fetch against the literal id 'not-found'; expected 404 is surfaced as console error repeatedly during route checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated: all requested public routes at 4 target viewports showed no horizontal overflow; mobile menu aria/body lock/Escape passed; reduced mode startup static behavior passed (data-motion=reduced, animated=0, transitioning=0, scrollBehavior=auto); customer keyboard picker flow passed with valid searchable value (e.g., 'financial' -> financial-services). Recheck touch targets and mobile form font-size after fixes.
rca of the issue: 1) Touch target: reproduce on '/' at 390x844; demo-guided-tour button in embedded showcase computes ~34px height. 2) Mobile text size: reproduce on '/demo' at 390x844; customer problem/search controls compute <16px. 3) Console: open '/map/not-found' and inspect console/network; repeated 404 logs from /api/decision-maps/not-found appear despite user-facing missing-state page rendering.
